Preserve its exact face and facial proportions, chin, jaw, cheeks, lips and nose, its particular direct gaze, brow and eyelid expression, pale gray-blue iris color, age and natural skin. Preserve image 1's head angle, body posture, jacket, shirt, framing, background and directional lighting. Do not "improve" the face, soften or intensify its expression, change eye direction, or replace it with the man in image 2.
